title: Modified Rao scarfed-nozzle MOC reference
description: NASA modified-Rao/scarfed-nozzle case with design Mach, area ratio, thrust coefficient, and Seagull MOC comparisons. This is a diagnostic MOC physics benchmark rather than a strict axisymmetric geometry case because the paper geometry is scarfed/truncated.

source.citation: NASA report on modified Rao scarfed nozzle design and Seagull analysis.
references: Analysis section: Rao method with control surface and MOC
Results: design Mach 6, gamma 1.4, area ratio 90, ramp length 300 in, cowl length 15 in
Figure 10: nozzle cowl length versus thrust coefficient
Figures 11-15: nontruncated geometry, pressure, velocity, wall Mach, and Mach contours
source.notes: The Rao program assumes a curved sonic line at the throat while Seagull assumes a straight sonic line. This makes the case useful for transonic starting-line diagnostics.

curves.axis_calibration: station axis 0 to 300, wall Mach approximate from OCR-visible figure

expected_physics_gaps: The current MOC starting-line model does not reproduce the published curved-sonic-line assumptions.
The current axisymmetric benchmark runner cannot reproduce scarfed/truncated external-flow effects.
Frozen/equilibrium chemistry and throat Mach > 1 starting data are not implemented in the current contour API.
